text.tspan: . The orchestrator guides each step and stops at the gates for your approval. The tests are written on the current version first, so the upgrade can't shape what is tested.
Prepare, test the current version, upgrade
tests must pass, then are locked
install it on the upgrade server
Merge our changes into the new
Write the added tests, then run
the full set on the upgrade
Fix what fails, up to three
rounds, else hand back to you
If the new platform only looks different, you approve updating that test
Nothing is checked in automatically: you sign off every change.
